Author: KeydenK
Name: Hats Off
Punchline: Automatically hides your headgear during cutscenes, only on your screen.
Description:
Tired of your helmet in every story moment? Hats Off hides your headgear while a cutscene plays and puts it back the moment it ends.

- Only you see it: nothing is sent to the server, other players keep seeing your hat.
- Hidden from the start, including on the copy of your character used in story cutscenes.
- Remembers your hat setting and puts exactly that back.
- Choose story/quest cutscenes, duty cutscenes, or both.
- Optional: also hide it while talking to NPCs, outside of cutscenes.

Requires Glamourer (which itself requires Penumbra).
Command: /hatsoff
